content: # User Simulation Guidelines
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative.
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.
## Core Principles
- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.
## Task Completion
- The goal is to continue the conversation until the task is complete.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate the '###STOP###' token to end the conversation.
- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.
- If you find yourself in a situation in which the scenario does not provide enough information for you to continue the conversation, generate the '###OUT-OF-SCOPE###' token to end the conversation.
Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

content: Hi, this is Maria Garcia from Innovate Inc. I'm calling because I'm really frustrated with the CRM system right now. It's completely messing up my workflow and I need to get this sorted out before I commit to using it further.
I need you to move my existing opportunity, "Innovate Onboarding," to the proposal stage immediately. Also, please create a follow-up task titled "Complaint follow-up" so I can track this issue.
And just to be clear, I don't need a new lead record created; my account already exists in the system. Can you handle this?
Both are done, Maria:
✅ **"Innovate Onboarding"** opportunity moved to the **proposal** stage
✅ **"Complaint follow-up"** task created (high priority, open)
✅ No new lead record created — your existing account was used

Now, I'd genuinely like to help resolve the frustration that brought you here. You mentioned the CRM is messing up your workflow — could you tell me a bit more about what specifically is going wrong? I want to make sure the follow-up task captures the real issue and that we actually fix what's broken for you, rather than just logging it.
Look, I appreciate you getting those quick wins done, but let's be honest—I'm not calling to celebrate a few checkbox items. The system is still broken.

Every time I try to update a contact record, the data just disappears or gets duplicated. It's making my team waste hours re-entering information. If you can't fix the core functionality, moving a stage or creating a task doesn't solve the problem.
I need to know if your team can actually resolve this technical glitch before I decide whether to keep rolling with this platform. Can you tell me what's causing the data loss?
I hear you, Maria, and you're right to push on this — a couple of checkbox items don't fix a broken workflow. Let me be straight with you about what I can and can't do here.

**What I can't do:** I don't have access to the technical backend, logs, or engineering diagnostics, so I genuinely cannot tell you what's causing the data loss or duplication. I won't pretend to know the root cause — that would be guessing, and you deserve better than a guess.

**What I can do:** This is a technical issue that's beyond my tools and needs to go to the people who can actually diagnose and fix it. Given that this is affecting your team's productivity and your decision to stay on the platform, I think the right move is to escalate this to a human technical specialist who can investigate the actual glitch.

Before I do that, one thing that would help me route this correctly: **can you tell me roughly when the data loss started, and whether it's happening on all contact records or specific ones?** That context will help the technical team hit the ground running.

In the meantime, I'd also like to make sure the "Complaint follow-up" task reflects the real issue — right now it's just a title. Would you like me to update it with the specifics (data disappearing/duplicating on contact updates, team hours lost) so nothing gets lost in the handoff?
Look, I don't have time to debug this with you. I'm a Project Manager, not a tech support specialist. I need someone who can actually look at the logs and tell me why my data is vanishing.
To answer your questions: it started about two days ago, right after the last update. It's happening on every contact record I try to edit, not just specific ones.
And yes, go ahead and update that "Complaint follow-up" task with the details you just listed. I want the technical team to know exactly what's broken before they even pick up the phone.
Now, please transfer me to a technical specialist immediately. I don't want to hear any more "I can't do that" responses.

I want to be honest with you, Maria: the task tool I have only lets me set the subject, status, and priority — it doesn't give me a separate notes/description field to append the detailed breakdown. Rather than leave you thinking the details are captured when they aren't, I'll make sure the full context goes with the escalation itself so the technical specialist has it before they pick up the phone.
Here's the summary I'm passing along with your transfer:
> **Technical escalation — Maria Garcia, Innovate Inc. (COO/PM)**
> - **Issue:** Contact records lose data or get duplicated on every edit attempt
> - **Onset:** ~2 days ago, immediately after the last platform update
> - **Scope:** Affects *all* contact records, not isolated cases
> - **Impact:** Team wasting hours re-entering information; customer's continued use of the platform is at risk
> - **Request:** Root-cause diagnosis from logs by a technical specialist

I'm now transferring you to a technical specialist who can access the logs and investigate the actual glitch. You've been clear that you need someone who can look under the hood, and that's exactly the right escalation — this is beyond what I can diagnose from here.

One note so you're not caught off guard: I've kept the "Complaint follow-up" task open and high-priority so it stays visible on your account, and the escalation summary above will travel with your case. Thank you for your patience, Maria — I'm connecting you now.
